title: View and Manage AP/AR Data OFF hides the three tabs on a customer
custom_preconds: 1. A user has a role with Customers View and View and Manage AP/AR Data OFF.
custom_expected: The Unpaid Invoices, Payments and Credits tabs are not shown.
evidence: UI: AP/AR Data OFF (Service Advisor) — the customer page shows only Work Orders/Part Sales/Contacts/Assets/Notes; the Invoices/Payments/Deposits tabs are hidden.
